_note: Held-out VALIDATION corpus for the phylogenetic sweep. Human core of chr8+chr11 only (k=0, no homologs): every condition's model predicts held-out HUMAN DNA, so all spreads validate on one identical ruler and their loss surfaces are comparable. Same orthologous-core definition (>=18 of the 20 core_species) as the training corpora, so train and val are the same distribution (the GC-enriched core), not the whole chromosome. Build with chr8+chr11 MAF. Output: val.bin -> point sweep.slurm --val-bin at it.
